effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in any of its traits to the hand and trash 1 such card among them. Place the rest at the bottom of your.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Undead] or [Dark Animal] trait from your trash for its digivolution cost.
